sameCaseV12NonFindComparison.scope: 52 non-Find cases use the same accepted original case references. Every candidate is independently checked against its original effects and actual storage. Explicit time rebasing can change timestamp fields and corresponding raw hashes; this is not a claim that historical and current raw roots are identical.

freshFindV12FeeComparison.scope: Six corresponding Find shapes use new archive entropy for V14 and therefore different actual found artifact IDs from V12. These are fee comparisons between separately accepted original/candidate pairs, not a replay of identical private inputs across V12 and V14.

feeScope: Complete mined local mock-network account or sponsored transactions, normalized from exact billed gas to one previously observed price schedule. Actual local receipt fees are separately reconciled. No live-network receipt quote, setup-inclusive workload estimate or proof-speed claim.
semanticScope: Exact original typed inputs and seeded states except explicitly refreshed top-level action time; normalized ordered game events checked on the final real-account transaction before broadcast; each deployment's actual complete state hashes and untouched seeded state checked after mining. Original and candidate raw hashes may differ when timestamp fields differ. Shared fresh Find entropy and found artifact IDs are retained exactly within each pair.
originalReferences: 52 cached canonical original non-Find rows plus six freshly mined original Find rows paired with the candidate using common recent archive entropy. The two already completed V14 public fee rows were reused unchanged; no duplicate candidate sends.
runtimeSuites: 75 separate V14 touch checks have completed and are packaged separately. Targeted final reader/trust/Give checks are pending at this fee snapshot. Historical V12 checks remain V12 evidence.
